tokens.name: ground-top
tokens.usage: Lavender ground: start of the 160-degree gradient. Also the flat fallback behind it.

tokens.name: ground-mid
tokens.usage: Lavender ground: the light middle of the gradient, at 46%.

tokens.name: ground-deep
tokens.usage: Lavender ground: end of the gradient. The safest flat ground for small cream text (7:1).

tokens.name: glow-peach
tokens.usage: The warm glow, one per screen, behind the thing that matters. Cream text over it is weak: put text on a card there, or set it 24px and larger with the shade shadow.

tokens.name: glow-pink
tokens.usage: Soft pink glow in the bottom left corner of the ground.

tokens.name: glow-violet
tokens.usage: Violet glow at the bottom edge of the ground.

tokens.name: glow-night
tokens.usage: Deep shade in the top right corner of the ground; the quiet side of a screen.

tokens.name: glyph
tokens.usage: Cream. Every plus, dash and dot drawn on the ground, and titles on it. 5.3:1 on ground-top, 7:1 on ground-deep; under 3:1 on ground-mid and on the peach glow, so text there is 24px or larger with the shade shadow.

tokens.name: cap
tokens.usage: Text on the ground: handwritten names, group words, italic lines. 4.8:1 on ground-top, 6.3:1 on ground-deep; same limits as glyph on the light parts.

tokens.name: pollen
tokens.usage: The name of the person who is explaining right now, and a name at the moment it receives a skill.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Text shadow under any text that sits directly on the ground: 0 1px 8px.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Cards and chips that sit on the ground.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Text on paper (14.8:1) and the main button on a card.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Lavender on paper: the after example, the arrow in the chip, a person's words on a card. 5:1 on paper; white text on it 5.4:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary lines on paper: when to use a skill, the time code. 4:1 on paper, so 13px lines in it are under the 4.5:1 floor: kept exact, to confirm.

tokens.name: listen
tokens.usage: Listening only: the pill, the light on the band, the app mark in a notification. Never a button, a link or decoration.

tokens.name: on-listen
tokens.usage: Text and the nine small pluses on the listening pill (5.1:1).

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: The dot of the i in the wordmark: the four dots in its centre. A bright blue-indigo of its own, not the listening blue. Used nowhere else. Exact shade to confirm.

tokens.name: dot-ring
tokens.usage: The eight small dots around the centre of the dot of the i.

tokens.name: lit
tokens.usage: A skill is passing right now: the two rings and the spot between them, drawn with a soft glow. Under 3:1 on every ground colour, read through hue and glow: to confirm on the projector.

tokens.name: word-cream
tokens.usage: Wordmark gradient, stops at 0% and 66%.

tokens.name: word-pink
tokens.usage: Wordmark gradient, stop at 38%.

tokens.name: word-blue
tokens.usage: Wordmark gradient, stop at 100%. Only inside the wordmark.

tokens.name: device
tokens.usage: The phone frame and the body of the band in mock-ups.

styles.name: wordmark-hero
styles.usage: The word as the main thing on a screen. Fine dots: font-variation-settings ELSH 50. The dot of the i is a cluster of small dots. Not yet seen on a projector.

styles.name: wordmark-corner
styles.usage: Top left corner of a screen. Not yet seen on a projector; the blue centre of the i is about 4px here.

styles.name: title-screen
styles.usage: The one title of a screen. Lower case.

styles.name: title-card
styles.sample: Open an update with the number
styles.usage: The title of a skill on a card.

styles.name: line
styles.sample: agents have skills. people have taste. tacit is how it gets around.
styles.usage: The tagline and any line that speaks. Lower case.

styles.name: phrase
styles.usage: A section heading on a card or a profile, and the word for a group on the network.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Use it when you report results: in a meeting, a message, a demo.
styles.usage: Running text. 20px or larger on a projector.

styles.name: body-small
styles.sample: Use it when you report results.
styles.usage: Secondary lines on a phone card.

styles.name: action
styles.sample: Try it on my next update
styles.usage: Buttons, and the word in the listening pill at weight 500.

styles.name: name-large
styles.usage: A person's name at the top of their profile.

styles.name: name
styles.usage: A name under a ring on the network; 22px when there are more than seven people.

styles.name: said
styles.sample: They forget the story. They remember 40%.
styles.usage: A person's own words, quoted exactly.

styles.name: path
styles.usage: A real file path or a time code. Small capital labels in this font are to confirm.

tokens.name: cell
tokens.usage: One grid step on a stage screen. Every mark sits in the middle of a cell and things move one cell at a time.

tokens.name: cell-phone
tokens.usage: One grid step on a phone.

tokens.name: cell-watermark
tokens.usage: One grid step in a small still drawing.

tokens.name: gap-chip
tokens.usage: Gap between the parts of a chip or pill.

tokens.name: pad-card
tokens.usage: Side padding of a card.

tokens.name: inset-stage
tokens.usage: Distance of the wordmark, the listening pill and the chip from the edge of a screen.

tokens.name: radius-stage
tokens.usage: A stage screen, buttons, the before and after bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Small tiles, the player, a notification.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: A paper card.

tokens.name: radius-screen
tokens.usage: The screen inside the phone frame.

tokens.name: radius-phone
tokens.usage: The phone frame.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The listening pill and the chip.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: A paper card on the ground.

tokens.name: shadow-chip
tokens.usage: The chip, a notification, the play button.

tokens.name: shadow-listen
tokens.usage: The white outline and blue halo of the listening pill.
